Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 훈련을 실패한 후, 단장인 나를 탓한다. 뭐라고 얘기할까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> is blaming me for her failing the training. What should I say?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はがトレーニングに失敗した後、団長である私を責める。何と声をかけようか？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>训练失败后，责怪着身为团长的我。该说什么好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>訓練失敗後，責怪著身為團長的我。該說什麼好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> me reproche son échec à l'entraînement. Que dois-je dire ? (correction: 'Que dois-je dire ?' is correct, but the sentence structure is awkward and lacks natural flow in French)
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat das Training nicht bestanden und schiebt mir die Schuld zu. Was soll ich sagen?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> me culpa al Capitán por su fracaso en el entrenamiento. ¿Qué debería decir?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> me culpa, o Capitão, após falhar no treinamento. O que devo dizer?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ทำพลาดในการฝึกซ้อม แล้วมาโทษฉันที่เป็นหัวหน้า จะพูดอะไรดีนะ?
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menyalahkan saya karena kegagalan latihannya. Apa yang harus saya katakan?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đổ lỗi cho tôi vì thất bại trong buổi huấn luyện. Tôi nên nói gì đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ट्रेनिंग में फेल होने के लिए मुझे दोष दे रही है। मुझे क्या कहना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: No hay remedio, descansa un rato
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไม่เป็นไร ไปพักกันสิ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Không thể làm gì khác, nghỉ ngơi đi
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: कोई चारा नहीं है, चलो ब्रेक लेते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: <color=#F7BE45>เบล รีส ออกไปวิ่ง</color>

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Je te donne un philtre de vitalité.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Te doy la poción de vitalidad.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Eu passo a poção de cura.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ส่งต่อการใช้พลัง
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Truyền cho một viên thuốc hồi phục.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: एक वाइटैलिटी पोशन दिया जाता है।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió detener el entrenamiento y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treino e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกซ้อมและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk menghentikan latihan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết định dừng huấn luyện và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने ट्रेनिंग रोककर आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours insatisfaite.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie beschloss, sich auszuruhen, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Decidimos descansar, pero <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece tener algunas reservas.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Decidi descansar, mas <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece ter ficado com um gostinho amargo.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อน แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังดูเสียดายอยู่บ้าง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih terlihat tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo y logró resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente e obteve resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองใหม่อีกครั้งและได้ผลลัพธ์ที่ดี
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi dan mencapai hasil yang solid.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thử lại và đạt được kết quả tốt.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम हासिल किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé mais a échoué une fois de plus.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut, scheiterte aber wieder.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero falló una vez más.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente, mas falhou mais uma vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองใหม่อีกครั้ง แต่ก็ยังล้มเหลว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thử lại nhưng lại thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर असफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 포션을 먹고 회복한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(와)과 함께 훈련을 이어나갔다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After recovering with the potion, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> and I resumed training together.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: ポーションを飲んで回復した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>と一緒にトレーニングを続けた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 和喝下药水恢复的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>一起继续了训练。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 和喝下藥水恢復的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>一起繼續了訓練。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir récupéré avec la potion, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> et moi avons repris l'entraînement ensemble.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sich mit dem Trank erholt hatte, setzten wir das Training gemeinsam fort.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de recuperarse con la poción, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> y yo reanudamos el entrenamiento juntos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após se recuperar com a poção, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> e eu retomamos o treino juntos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ฝึกซ้อมต่อกับ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ฟื้นฟูจากการดื่มยา
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah pulih dengan ramuan, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dan aku melanjutkan latihan bersama.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi hồi phục bằng thuốc, tôi và <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tiếp tục huấn luyện cùng nhau.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन से ठीक होने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> और मैंने एक साथ ट्रेनिंग फिर से शुरू की।
